balls.text: Dropped Kumar backs away and gets a thick edge which swirls to Chawla at third man, he covered enough ground but the ball slips through his fingers, that denies Abdulla a five-for
makes room and Abdulla fires it wide outside off and the batsman swings and misses
throws the kitchen sink at that one after backing away and he gets a lucky inside edge which beats the keeper
jams out a yorker and the ball just spins away from Chawla at short third man
he swings and misses and they steal a bye, the keeper under arms it to the bowler who has a shy at the stumps at his end as well
he follows up the bouncer with a straight yorker which goes right through the gate and pushes the legstump back, Kumble had exposed all 3 stumps
bangs in the bouncer in seeing the batsman back away, right call by the umpire
backs away to a low full toss and he gets a faint edge which trickles to the keeper
makes room, gets to the pitch of the ball and scoops it to wide long-off
makes room, tries to steer it to the off side but misses it
fires it full on the offstump and he jams it out hard to long-off
full toss outside off and he fails to make contact
it's a full ball and he kneels down and tries to scoop him over the sight screen but he doesn't get the elevation and Chawla takes the catch running to his left from long-on
full and driven to long-off
angles it on the pads and he clips it high over square leg, what timing

another mis-hit and it lands down Irfan's throat at deep extra cover! He gets on his knee and tries to pick him over the on side but it goes the other way and Irfan completes the catch while looking into the lights
that's a mis-hit! He specialises in those shots alright, his leg moves back as he tries to crash it over the onside but he sends it over wide long -off instead
makes room and crashes a half volley past deep extra cover, he just slaps it with brute power
makes room and lofts him downtown and tries to clear long-on, Srivastava tries to get underneath it and he leaps up and palms it over the rope, very tough one
bowls it on the blovkhole and he jams it to point
inswinging yorker just misses the legstump, they try to steal a bye but Kohli turns back and just makes his ground before Irfan hits the stumps
slower delivery outside off, he gets on his knee and fetches it from outside off and tonks it over midwicket, just a few inches short of the rope
gets forward and scampers a single to point, the throw was just wide
comes over the wicket to van der Merwe, he taps it to the off side and sets off
slower delivery from round the wicket and he pushes it softly to the covers
gets to the pitch and drives him to long-off
full on middle and leg and pushed to long-on
fired on the pads and he clips it against the turn to midwicket
chops it to the off side
lands outside off and he chops it down to point
turn and bounce, beats him completely and sanga fumbles behind the stumps
it's a half volley outside off and he gets on his knee and crashes it hard past deep extra cover
lands outside off and he drives to deep cover
tossed up outside off, he gets on his knee and slogs him from outside off and clears deep midwicket
the googly I reckon, he defends close to the pads and that prompts an appeal
shapes to cut but misses
another appeal for an lbw, he lunges forward and he;s struck just outside the line of the offstiump
drops it short and he frees his arms and scoops it over gully, well just wide of gully

That's hat-trick No.4 in the IPL! That's yet another arm ball which fetches him a wicket, he slips in the fast arm ball which lands on the offstump, skids through and clips his front pad in front of the stumps as he shapes to work it to the on side, the umpire lifts the finger immediately
short on the offstump and he gets a bit of turn, he pulls from outside off and places it to deep square
angles it on the pads and he nudges it to short square leg for a single
full on the pads and he sweeps him wide of square leg
tries to sweep him but the ball hits his back leg outside the line of the offstump
makes a bit of room and cuts with the turn to sweeper cover
commits to the front foot and defends
the arm ball foxes him! Lands on the offstump and goes straight through, Kallis is too late to get his bat down and the ball shaves the off stump
Uthappa tries to go over the top with a slog and he gets a thick top edge, Katich runs forward from deep midwicket and takes the skier
angles it towards the body and he clips it wide of midwicket
gets forward and drives to long-off
wide down the leg side
full outside off and he slams it past the covers with brute force, that scorched to the boundary in a flash
gets on his knee and slogs him over midwicket, lot of power behind that shot

tucks it to the right of Chawla and sets off for a quick single, Kallis is struggling to make his ground and the bowler fires the ball to the keeper, he whips off the bails and the batsman is home, the third umpire takes a look
he's not afraid to slog him against the turn, deep square picks it up
full outside off and driven to ex tra cover
gives him the charge and he lofts him over mid-off, the fielder in the deep mops up
fullish in length outside off and he slogs him to deep midwicket
skids through, keeps low and he whips it towards midwicket for a single
pushes it flatter and shorter and he gets a thick edge onto his body as he shapes to pull
taps it softly to the off side and he thinks of a single but changes his mind
tossed up outside off and pushed to the off side
tosses it up and Kallis shapes to scoop it over cover but he changes his mind and carves it over point instead
goes for a wild cut and misses it, he doesn't pick the arm ball
gets forward and drives to deep cover
steps down and whacks a full delivery to long-off
rush of blood as he shapes to slog him from outside off, the ball turns sharply and the bat is nowhere close
slow off the pitch and he defends it away
strays wide down the leg side
gets turn and bounce and beats the outside edge
full outside off and pushed back to the bowler
flicked to midwicket
risky shot in the end, he gives it a lot of flight and delivers it wide outside off, Uthappa reaches out to cut and gets a thick outside edge which beats the keeper
clips it with the turn wide of midwicket
pushes a full delivery down to long-on
gives it a lot of flight and he pushes a low full toss to long-on
stays back, waits for the turn and punches it to long-on
it's a half volley outside off and Kallis times the drive very crisply past the covers, the ball races past Powar who runs across and perhaps a dive could have saved a run or two
good length outside off and driven to the off side
Uthappa gets a lifter and he gets on his toes and tries to fend it off but the outside edge just falls short of Jayawardene's right at slip
drives to deep cover for a single

Abdulla gets a bit of extra bounce and that wrecks Goswami's plan of timing it over the ropes, he tries to clear it over cover point but gets a top edge and Chawla runs forward from the boundary and catches it
reaches out and drives a full delivery down to the covers
chipped in the air just wide of midwicket and the cries of 'catch it' go up
Can't call that a drop! Very tough one, Kallis gets a leading edge as he tries to work it to the on side and Mahela leaps up at slip and tries to pull off a blinder
gives him the charge and another one flies off the top edge, Abdulla tries to get around it at third man but the ball dips in front of him
he frees his arms on seeing a bit of width and scoops him high over backward point, not well timed
cramps him for room on the offstump and Goswami gets behind the line and defends
gets beside the line and steers it straight to point
tests him out with a short one and that gets high on Kallis who defends

Punjab saw it coming, Abdulla keeps it full outside the offstump and invites the uppish drive, Bishnoi obliges and ends up tamely chipping it to Chawla at short cover, there was a packed off side field waiting for that offering
big swing and a miss, if you pitch it up to him he will flash hard, he hasn't connected those at all today
yorker on the pads and he fails to whip it away, the ball rolls down the pitch
Abdulla bowls one full and has Bishnoi playing an airy drive, he misses it completely
rolls his wrists and clips a low full toss to mid-on
drops it in front of mid-off and sets off for a quick single
Dropped Goswami gets a thin outside edge to a delivery angling away from him and Sangakkara dives to his left and gets a glove to it, Powar mops up at third man, tough chance
tries to whack a low full toss but he mistimes it and the ball dips in front of mid-on
take that! Malik drops it short of  a length outside off and Bishnoi swivels and pulls powerfully over deep midwicket, lot of bottom hand on that shot
this time Bishnoi connects properly! He swivels after seeing a short delivery and hooks him high over long leg, that went quite a few rows back
he opens the face of the bat and steers it late to third man
gets forward and punches it off the front foot to the covers, he can;t beat the infield
full and swinging away and he pushes a low full toss off the bottom of the bat to the covers
Goswami gets nicely behind the line and pushes  it back to the bowler off the meat of the bat
gets late swing and Goswami manages to get his bat down and keep away a yorker
lands it on a good length outside off and he gets beside the line and taps it to the off side
extra bounce and the ball hits his handle
streaky! Malik bangs it in short and Bishnoi swivels and pulls, the top edge lands safe and beats the fielder at fine leg
short and wide outside off and chopped to point
Chance! Bishnoi pulls a short delivery from outside off and doesn't time it well, he ball dips in front of Srivastava at mid-on, good attempt though
short of a length and he shuffles and clips it to square leg
just slides down the legside and he tries to flick it away and misses

appeal for an lbw! He really gets it to swing back in and lands it on a yorker length and it appears to strike him just outside the line of the offstump,, Dharmasena shakes his head, perhaps there was bat involved
Mahela's taken it! Ryder prods forward at a delivery which straightens outside the offstump and the thick outside edge is taken by Jayawardene who falls to his right at first slip
rolls his wrists and clips a full delivery across the line and beats midwicket
slams it hard to the off side and Katich makes his presence felt with a brilliant save
gets nicely behind the line and pushes it to mid-off
lands it oustide off and gets nice away movement and the ball bounces twice before reaching the keeper
a hat-trick it won't be but Bangalore won't complain because they've upstaged Punjab! He cuts hard to point
timber! He fires in a fast yorker swinging in, Chawla chases it and gets a thik inside edge which flattens his offstump

Praveen gets away with a low full toss! Pathan stays at the crease and tries to club him over the sight screen but he strikes the ball off the bottom half of the bat and Kohli makes no mistake at long-on
superb change of pace, he swishes and meets thin air
take that! Irfan Pathan gets on his knee to a full delivery and square drive with brute power wide of deep backward point
Praveen jams in the yorker outside off and the batsman cannot dig it out
driven hard down the ground and an excellent save by Kohli at wide long-on saves the team two precious runs
attempts a reverse sweep and he misses
steps down the track and Kumble drops it short, he scoops it to deep point, there's hesitation for the second run
makes room and cuts to the off side
look at Kumble celebrate! He slips in the googly and drops it a bit short, Sanga makes room and tries to slap it somewhere but he fails to read the googly and loses his middle stump
drops it a bit short and he swings and the ball just misses the top of the stumps
pushes it to long-on and they call quickly for the second run and Sanga makes his ground, the throw was just wide of the bowler
comes down the pitch and the bowler fires a high full toss, he swings and fails to make proper contact
full outside off and jammed to cover
another bad delivery down the leg side, had the batsman got bat on it it would have disappeared for four
rank bad delivery and van der Merwe is peeved with himself! Full toss down the leg side and Pathan bashes it past short fine leg, oh well!
appeal for an lbw! He fires it down the leg side and Boucher thought it struck him in line with the leg stump, the ball beats him and runs away for four, leg byes signalled
now there's a twist in the tale! Jayawardene gets on his knee and tries to slice it high down to deep backward point but he ends up splicing it down to Kallis at backward point
he fetches that from wide outside off and places it to deep square-leg
makes room and Praveen gives him width to free his arms and he squirts it to deep cover
misdirects the leg cutter wide of the offstump and wide called
stays at the crease and biffs it off the front foot to long-off
he comes over the wicket and bowls a full toss and he taps it wide of cover
almost a repeat of the previous shot! He kneels down, backs away and drives it squarer this time - in the region of deep backward point
that will come as a relief for Punjab! Praveen bowls it full outside off from round the wicket, Jayawardene makes room, kneels down and slices it past the gap between gully and point, super shot
backs away and tries to pierce the infield on the off side
makes room and cuts square of the wicket on the off side for two more
pushes it towards mid-on and they rush through for the second run
chops it down to point
makes room and slaps it to the off side
gets forward and pushes it to midwicket
gets across his stumps and tries to sweep him but he's outside the line of the offstump
chops it down to point and they scamper through for a single
punches it hard off the meat of the bat but finds Kumble at cover
punches it down to long-on off the full face of the bat
attempts a golf swing over long-on but he meets thin air again
swings hard and misses
he clubs a full toss over midwicket but the ball drops short of the fielder
driven hard down the pitch and Appanna does well to intercept it
drives hard down the pitch and he fields well off his own bowling
he gets on his knee and sweeps and exploits the big gap at long leg
flicks it to deep midwicket

a run out chance fluffed! Sanga chips down and lofts towards deep mid-on, Uthappa fires the throw to the bowler and Jayawardene is half way down the pitch for the second run, Appanna hesitates before throwing the ball to Boucher
nips back in off the pitch and the ball clips him high on the pads
gets forward and defends

brilliant work by van der Merwe! Sanga steers it to van der Merwe's left and risks the single, the fielder slides, collects it, turns around while still on all fours and hurls the ball to Boucher who whips off the bails, not need for the third umpire
gets forward and punches it towards the covers
that's a gift on the pads and Sanga obliges by flicking it away and finding the big gap at fine leg
shuffles and works it to the on side
wants to pull but the ball keeps low, must have got an inside edge
gets on the front foot and drives to long-on
he shuffles across and looks to paddle it away and he beats the keeper and the ball runs away to fine leg, the umpire signals byes but the batsman actually got some bat on it
pushed hard back to the bowler
flighted outside off and he gets on his knee and clears midwicket
works it to the on side
just after the strategic time-out! He tosses it up on middle and off and Goel goes downtown and tries to clear long-on but he hits it too flat and finds Kohli
gets well forward and defends off the meat of the bat
flighted on middle and leg and he pushes this to the on side
missed stumping! He tries to work it to the on side but the ball skids through and Boucher fails to gather the ball
full on middle and leg and he pushes it to long-on
shuffles across his stumps and tucks it just past midwicket
pushes it to the on side

an entertaining innings comes to a tame end, he gets on his knee and attempts another slog sweep to clear deep midwicket but he doesn't quite get to the pitch of the ball and gets a thick top edge, Kallis pedals back and takes the catch outside the 30-yard ring
he's unstoppable tonight folks! Pitched up on middle and leg and he slogs sweeps him over deep midwicket, that went a few rows back, that's his fifty too
gets forward and defends
steps down the track and sweeps and the ball hits his pads and rolls away, they appeal for an lbw but the ball was hitting him outside leg
gets on his knee early and sweeps him down to deep square-leg
another of his clean hits! He makes a bit of room to a pitched up delivery outside off, gets to the pitch and biffs a flat six just over the rope at long-off
full outside off and jammed hard to long-off
closes the face of the bat and clips it to midwicket
slaps it off the middle of the bat but finds the diving fielder at backward point
slashes hard at a wide delivery and gets a thick outside edge to third man
there's a big gap at midwicket and he chips it on the up in that region
taps it down the pitch and nearly loses his balance after playing the shot
he fails to pick the googly, another one beats the batsman
this one goes through straight and beats the outside edge
defends the googly
tosses it up and he attempts another slog but he ends up ploughing it to midwicket
Yuvraj goes big, high and half a dozen! He gets on his knee and slog sweeps him high over deep square leg and it's out of the ground, while they replace the ball, the players take drinks
gets an inside edge to the on side
pounds it hard down the ground to long-on
flicks it to short midwicket
he nonchalantly whips him straight and hard down the ground, I don't think mid-on even saw that, the ball was in the air for a bit
comes back well with a fast yorker, well dug out
welcome to the bowling crease Sir Roelof, says Yuvraj! Overpitched on middle and leg and he scoops it high over long-on
shuffles and clips it with the angle to square leg
kallis falls over on the follow through, Goel knocks it hard to the on side
he clubs it hard down the ground and mid-on slides and cuts it off
hooks a gets a thick top edge which swirls on the air and drops just short of the fine leg rope, Bishnoi does really well to slide and cut it off
lands it short and the ball kicks up and he manages to fend it off
makes room and deliberately angles it down to third man
full and he fails to make contact on the drive
strange shot by Goel as he shapes to pull and mis-hits it to the off side, the ball was in the air for a few seconds
slices it just wide of Kohli at point and he has a shy at the stumps at they attempt a sharp single
slices it hard to Kohli at point
it's a full toss and Yuvraj despite checking his shot manages to power it past the bowler and mid-on, that was off the middle of the bat
attempts a massive golf swing over long-on but the ball passes his offstump, wild swing and a miss
responds with a bouncer and he safely ducks under it
too short and the bounce sits up nicely for Goel who biffs it with power over mid-on, that's like  a powerful forehand in tennis
short outside off and he places it to third man
Yuvraj picks the yawning gap at fine leg, the ball is on the pads and he just helps it on its way down to fine leg, the fielder was very square
gets a nice stride forward and he defends off the meat of the bat
slightly short and he plays a short arm pull which just beats midwicket
pitches it up and Goel pushes the ball to the off side
but thats timed by Goel, plonking the foot forward and drilling the slower ball, 113ks, back over the bowler's head, fine shot that
short ball again, pulled in the air over square, drops in front of sweeper
too far down the pads and a wide is the result
makes some room to leg stump, takes a step down, but PK is too sharp and spots him and holds back the length to draw another checked shot to the off side
goes to pull a short ball but gets it off the toe end and it rolls to mid-on
thats a poor shot from Yuvraj, starting to move forward but then not to the pitch of that delivery, he checks the shot and the ball pops up and drops in no man's land
pitches short of a length outside leg stump, Goel tries to turn it away but doesn't get the desired timing so thats the end of a very good over from Kallis
fuller length and the angle across beats a loose drive outside off
down the track he comes, clubbing the ball toward mid-on, scampers down and gets sent back and Yuvraj makes it home as the throw is astray from the fielder
bangs in a clever short ball, Goel pulls out, thats a good delivery
closer to off stump this time and Goel defends to point
sees room and opens the face to steer it down to third man
gets beside the line and chops it down to the slips
swings it away late and he clips it across the line to square leg
teases him outside off and Goel plays a half hearted punch and misses the ball
hangs his bat out and gets a thick outside edge past the two slips
gets a bit of late away movement, Yuvraj gets beside the line and steers it to the off side
lets the first one go to the keeper, the ball holds its line
